sources.findings: ProgramBench supplies a compiled binary and documentation and asks for a complete implementation of its behavior. Resolved and Almost are distinct metrics; the latter means at least 95 percent of behavioral tests. Hidden tests do not prove correctness for every possible input.

sources.findings: Official scoring requires a complete benchmark frame; partial samples have no official score. Binding revisions identify cell inputs. Infrastructure errors are excluded from the native score and reported as error_trials. Preserve that official calculation and also report every planned experimental attempt and missing-outcome bounds.

scope_limits: Source review does not qualify a benchmark environment, license, native scorer or model run.
Task previews and model training exposure limit unseen-task claims.
Official metric denominators must remain separate from all-planned-attempt experimental accounting.
